ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture is a food web, labeled with Sharks, Sea otters, Large fish, Sea urchins, Small fish, Crabs and Seaweed. Seaweed is located at the bottom of the picture, and there are arrows from Seaweed pointing to Sea urchins, Small fish and Crabs. Reasoning: In a food web, producers are usually plants or algae that can make their own food, and are located at the base position of the food web. Seaweed is seaweed, is at the bottom and is eaten by other organisms, so it is the producer.
